dedupe_keys.name: itc net mingledapp mixed android application traffic

description: ITC-Net-MingledApp contains concurrent traffic from thirty-six Android applications across different providers, users and locations. ITC-LAB at the University of Tehran documents captures in Tehran, Qom and Baghdad from 25 March–25 August 2024. Human-operated phones generate five-to-fifteen-minute sessions, yielding roughly thirty-five million packets and 399,000 bidirectional flows across the study. Five Mendeley deposits hold Qom, two Tehran partitions, Baghdad and supporting documentation with Python preprocessing scripts, all free under CC BY 4.0. The release is treated as one collection. Repository metadata identify PCAP captures and note that Baghdad includes twenty-three applications. Coverage excludes filtered background traffic and differs by location, limiting whole-network demand estimates. One Tehran cross-link incorrectly points to the Baghdad deposit, so all five identities are retained explicitly. Modellers could assess application-mix and domain-shift assumptions in traffic simulations. platform-ns-3 is related, without verified replay. No packet archive or filtering script was downloaded or executed.
